title: Pixelbolt rigid bodies
description: Rigid bodies (balls, boxes, convex polygons, fixed or spinning hoops) with gravity, walls, pixel obstacles, joints, ropes and cloth, simulated and baked into editable palette grids: they bounce, slide, roll, stack, knock each other about, swing, sag, drape and tear, then come to rest. Units: pixels and frames. One-shot; deterministic.

name.description: Portable name: do not use Windows device names (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1–9, LPT1–9). Frame/animation names must be unique ignoring case.

subpixels.description: Draw the bodies this many times finer than the world's pixels: each pixel of a body's picture turns as a square and the body sits where it is to a fraction of a pixel, so it turns and moves smoothly without changing shape; the obstacles and background are drawn in blocks this size. The recipe's canvas is width and height times this, at most 256 a side and 4,194,304 pixels over its frames. Default 1, bodies at whole pixels.

$ref.description: Shared palette file, resolved by the CLI and MCP relative to this recipe. Local entries add to or override it.

anchor.description: [x, y] in unscaled canvas pixels; the top-left corner of that pixel.

trim.description: Pack each frame by its visible bounds; the atlas reports trimmed rectangles with spriteSourceSize. Ignores columns. Frames whose visible pictures are the same (a hold, a frame moved whole) share one rectangle.

propertyNames.description: Portable name: do not use Windows device names (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1–9, LPT1–9). Frame/animation names must be unique ignoring case.

symbols.description: Named rows of palette keys for obstacles and body sprites; dot or space is empty.

propertyNames.description: Portable name: do not use Windows device names (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1–9, LPT1–9). Frame/animation names must be unique ignoring case.

effects.description: Names become animations and frame names; unique ignoring case. At most 256 frames in all.

frames.description: At most 256 in a recipe (and in all of a source's effects); a longer match goes out as numbered video frames: pixelbolt sequence, or pixel_compile with sequence.

walls.description: Canvas edges that hold bodies in; a body far past an open edge leaves for good, but one thrown past the edge gravity pulls it back from (over the top) comes back.

draw.description: over (default), under the bodies, or none (an invisible wall).

solid.description: false: a decoration the bodies pass.

bounce.description: How much of its approach speed a body keeps in a bounce: 0 lands dead, 1 bounces back as fast. A pair bounces with the larger. Default 0.3.

friction.description: Sliding friction; a pair uses the square root of the product. Default 0.4.

obstacles.description: Symbols stamped on the canvas whose pixels are solid. Bodies slide along their edges without catching on the seams between pixels.

size.description: With split: [columns, rows]. Default: as many as fit the canvas.

name.description: Portable name: do not use Windows device names (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1–9, LPT1–9). Frame/animation names must be unique ignoring case.

color.description: A one-character palette key; dot and space are reserved.

label.description: Shown by {leader}. Default the name in capitals.

rows.description: One character a cell: a team's colour, or . for a cell no one owns.

split.description: Instead of rows: the board shared out among the teams in order, side by side or one above the next.

territory.description: Cells owned by teams, drawn in their colours: a team's body passes its own and bounces off the others', claiming each it hits (the metadata counts them each frame).

name.description: Names the body in the metadata (its path, frame by frame, and when it leaves the canvas). Copies are numbered name-0, name-1, …

shape.description: circle (radius; 0.5 is one pixel), box (size), polygon (convex points) or hoop (a ring of thin walls with an optional gap, for a fixed container).

radius.description: circle: 0.5–32 pixels, drawn as an ellipse of diameter round(2 × radius). hoop: 2–128.

points.description: polygon: 3–8 convex points [x, y] around the body's centre, recentred on their centroid (at places the centroid). A symbol stays where the points were written: its middle on the point they are written around.

sides.description: hoop: straight walls around it. Default: its radius, from 8 to 64.

gap.description: hoop: degrees left open, centred on the hoop's angle (0 points right, 90 down). Default 0, closed.

thickness.description: hoop: wall thickness in pixels. Default 1.

at.description: Centre [x, y] in canvas pixels; [10.5, 10.5] is the middle of pixel (10, 10). The centre of a ring or the first copy of a grid. With pivot, where the pivot is.

pivot.description: Fixed body: the point it turns about, [x, y] from its centre before it turns (a blade about its hilt: [-length / 2, 0]); at places it. Default its centre.

angle.description: Degrees clockwise. Default 0. Drawn to the whole degree with straight, even sides (under 6 pixels across, always square); collisions use the exact angle.

velocity.description: Starting velocity [x, y] in pixels a frame; for a fixed body, how it moves for ever. Speeds stop at 8.

spin.description: Starting spin in degrees a frame, clockwise; for a fixed body, how it turns for ever.

fixed.description: Never pushed: a wall, peg or container. With velocity or spin it moves exactly so, pushing what it meets.

weightless.description: Gravity doesn't pull it: it floats where it is put, drifting only when hit.

asleep.description: Starts asleep: holds exactly still, even in the air, until something moves into it.

tireless.description: Every hit gives back the energy (speed plus height against gravity) the hit cost, so a ball keeps bouncing at full height among loose blocks. An open cheat; off by default.

speed.description: Held speed, pixels a frame: set back to it along its heading after every step, so a ball crossing a board never tires. An open cheat, like tireless.

team.description: A territory team's name: the body passes through that team's cells, bounces off the other teams' and claims each one it hits.

density.description: Mass per square pixel. Default 1. A heavier body pushes lighter ones about and keeps its own speed.

bounce.description: How much of its approach speed a body keeps in a bounce: 0 lands dead, 1 bounces back as fast. A pair bounces with the larger. Default 0.3.

friction.description: Sliding friction; a pair uses the square root of the product. Default 0.4.

drag.description: About the share of its speed lost each frame. Default 0.

spinDrag.description: About the share of its spin lost each frame. Default 0.02.

oneOf.description: A one-character palette key; dot and space are reserved.

items.description: A one-character palette key; dot and space are reserved.

fill.description: Palette key, or a list the body steps through at each hit.

fillEvery.description: With a list of fills: the list steps every this many frames instead of at each hit. The body keeps its fill until it splits; then it and its copies take the fill of that frame, so each generation of a crowd that multiplies has its own colour.

outline.description: Key for the pixels on the shape's edge.

symbol.description: Draw this symbol instead of fill and outline, centred on the body and turned with it to the whole degree, its outline kept a closed line (under 6 pixels across, in quarter turns).

color.description: A one-character palette key; dot and space are reserved.

items.description: A one-character palette key; dot and space are reserved.

colors.description: The most recent part of the sweep first.

smear.description: The shape swept over its last frames, drawn under it, banded from the first colour behind it to the last: a blade's swish. Not for a hoop.

at.description: How hard a knock breaks it: the speed it is hit at where it is hit (with the bounce), in pixels a frame, shared with what hits it by how easily each gives there. Default 3.

pieces.description: Pieces it breaks into, fewer where a piece would be too small to read. Default 6.

speed.description: Pixels a frame the pieces fly apart at, away from where it was hit, on top of its own motion. Default 0.5.

breaks.description: A free body that breaks when knocked hard enough, in a pixelforge-bodies source: into convex pieces cut through its shape about where it was hit, smaller there, each a body of its own carrying its part of the picture. Pieces do not break again.

from.description: Degrees of the first copy. Default 0.

to.description: Degrees of the last; default a full turn, spaced evenly.

bodies.description: At most 256 bodies with their copies. May be empty when the effect has cloths or ropes.

name.description: Optional name, reported when the joint breaks.

a.description: A named body, or "world" for a fixed point in the canvas.

b.description: A named body, or "world" for a fixed point in the canvas.

type.description: distance: both ends stay a length apart. rope: only pulls when farther than max. spring: a soft distance. hinge: the two anchors stay together and the bodies turn freely (with an optional angle limit). weld: the anchors and the relative angle stay fixed.

anchorA.description: Point on a in its own pixels. With a: "world", the world point.

anchorB.description: Point on b in its own pixels. With b: "world", the world point.

length.description: Distance (or spring rest length) in pixels; default the distance the bodies start at. A rope uses it as max when max is omitted.

max.description: Rope: longest length it allows. Default length, or the distance the bodies start at.

stiffness.description: How hard a spring pulls (0.4) or the fraction of the position error a distance joint corrects; default 1.

damping.description: Velocity lost along the joint. Default 0.

break.description: Impulse that breaks it; omitted, it never breaks.

collide.description: Whether the two bodies still collide. Default false, so a ragdoll's neighbours or a rope's links pass through each other.

limit.description: Hinge: the allowed relative angle [smallest, largest] in degrees.

joints.description: Constraints between named bodies, or between a body and the world.

body.description: A named body to hang this end from.

point.description: Point on the body, in its own pixels. Default [0, 0].

at.description: Or a fixed world point [x, y].

body.description: A named body to hang this end from.

point.description: Point on the body, in its own pixels. Default [0, 0].

at.description: Or a fixed world point [x, y].

links.description: Cargo links in the chain. Default 12.

slack.description: Extra length as a share of the span, so it sags. Default 0.15.

look.description: rope: a line. chain: a link at each body. Default rope.

fill.description: A one-character palette key; dot and space are reserved.

outline.description: Optional outline key for a rope line.

break.description: Joint impulse that splits the rope; omitted, it never breaks.

draw.description: Under the bodies (default) or over them.

ropes.description: Chains of link bodies drawn as a rope or a chain, with optional break thresholds.

at.description: Top-left particle [x, y] in canvas pixels.

size.description: [columns, rows] of particles; cells are drawn between them.

mask.description: Rows of # for cloth and . for a hole; the size must match.

oneOf.description: A one-character palette key; dot and space are reserved.

items.description: A one-character palette key; dot and space are reserved.

fill.description: A key, or 1–8 keys from dark to light used as the fold ramp.

back.description: Key for the back of a folded cell; default the ramp follows its light.

light.description: Direction toward the light for fold shading. Default [0, -1].

wind.description: Wind acceleration [x, y] in pixels a frame². Default [0, 0].

gust.description: How much the wind varies in time and across the cloth, flapping across it. Default 0.

slack.description: Extra rest length as a share, so the cloth can billow. Default 0.05.

shear.description: Diagonal constraint strength relative to structural. Default 0.4.

bend.description: Skip-one constraint strength relative to structural. Default 0.2.

tear.description: A constraint breaks when stretched past this multiple of its rest length; omitted, the cloth never tears.

draw.description: Over the bodies (default) or under them.

collide.description: Collide with obstacles and bodies. Default true.

to.description: A named body: the pin follows its local point.

keys.description: Or [frame, x, y] keys the pin follows, held before the first and after the last.

pins.description: Hold particles to fixed points, keyed points or named bodies.

cloths.description: Cloth grids pinned to points, keys or bodies, with wind, collisions and tearing.

most.description: The most bodies split powers and breaks may make in all, copies and pieces included: at least the bodies listed. Default 256, or room for every body with breaks to break into all its pieces (up to 4096).

size.description: Pixels a side; default the symbol's size, or 5.

power.description: split: copies turned about its heading; grow: a bigger body for frames; speed: its held speed (or speed) times factor for frames; warp: moves it to to; magnet: pulls the other teams' bodies toward to (default the pickup) for frames; vanish: the body is gone (an event may take a fixed body away: a ring bursts); break: the body breaks into count pieces, each carrying its part of the picture (an event may break a fixed body, whose pieces fall).

label.description: For {news}. Default the power in capitals.

count.description: split: bodies after. Default 3. break: pieces. Default 6.

to.description: warp, magnet: a canvas point [x, y], each from minus the canvas side to twice it.

frames.description: grow, speed, magnet: how long. Default 120.

pickups.description: Power-ups the first body to reach one takes.

rest.description: Frames before a body can take this strike again. Default 10.

cut.description: Cut instead of push: the body passes through the free bodies it touches, and what it strikes leaves behind it at this speed (pixels a frame), the pieces of a split fanned about that way, so they lie in its wake.

text.description: {team} cells, {team%} share, {leader}, {news} (the last power's label, for news frames), {frame}.

color.description: A one-character palette key; dot and space are reserved.

scale.description: Default 1; at most 16 divided by subpixels.

size.description: [width, height] in canvas pixels; at most 512 divided by subpixels.

empty.description: A one-character palette key; dot and space are reserved.

hud.description: With a territory: the score drawn over everything, every frame.
